description: Grouped checklist table component tag contract. Table-shape-level metadata only: no cell, row, or slot tags and no nested child components.

efficio_component_type.description: Identifies this shape as a grouped checklist table component.

efficio_groups.description: Table-level group definitions, stored as JSON text in the PowerPoint custom tag. Each group carries a stable key, a display label, an inclusion policy, and optional suggested items.

ai.purpose: Defines the stable groups the table is built from. Each group's key, label, and inclusion_policy must be echoed back. suggested_items are author hints, not required output; min_items, max_items, and max_chars_per_item are strict requirements, not guidance: each generated group must contain at least min_items and at most max_items items, and each item must never exceed max_chars_per_item characters — shorten or compact items until every limit is satisfied.

key.description: Stable identifier for the group within the table.

inclusion_policy.description: How strongly this group should be kept when generating content.

min_items.description: Minimum number of items this group must contain when generated — a strict requirement, not a hint.

max_items.description: Maximum number of items this group may contain when generated — a strict limit that must never be exceeded.

max_chars_per_item.description: Maximum characters for each generated item — a strict limit that must never be exceeded; shorten or compact items until they fit.

prompt_instruction.description: Optional per-group guidance for generating this group's items.

suggested_items.description: Optional author-provided example items for the group.

example.efficio_prompt_instruction: Generate grouped action items that respect each group's inclusion policy.
